description: Cross-binding conformance for a data loader's declared `unit_conversion` (esm-spec §8.5): "either a plain multiplicative factor or a full Expression AST (§4); the runtime applies it when producing values in the declared `units`". The runtime here is the ESIO provider path — `providers_from_document` + the per-variable provider each binding hands to `prepare` — which is where a loader-fed model actually gets its numbers. Each fixture pairs a document with a golden of the arrays that path must DELIVER, computed independently of any binding; the comparison is BYTE-IDENTITY on the f64 bits, not a tolerance, because a unit conversion is the last thing that touches a delivered array and a disagreement here is a disagreement about the numbers the model integrates. Every fixture also names the variables that declare NO conversion, and the adapter asserts those come back as the raw on-disk column bit for bit — the no-op property, which is what makes adding this safe for every document that declares nothing.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no ESIO provider path
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no ESIO provider path
